mostWorthwhile.text: Making an imagined beast from a remembered animal and a story was satisfying: it showed imagination as rearranging familiar features.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment in the cave was straightforward preparation rather than an especially interesting decision.

surprise.text: The remembered animal was merely absent, not imaginary; combining its painting with a story created an invented creature.
